metadata.scope: Official Halifax Regional Council historical meeting-table inventory exposed by the pre-eSCRIBE agendas/meetings/reports search. Date-cell status text such as Cancelled or Rescheduled is preserved separately. This is meeting/minutes discovery evidence only; it is not Council decision extraction and not payment evidence.
metadata.earlier_archive_boundary: The current filtered table itself spans 2016-01-12 through 2024-11-05, including 2016 records despite general page copy referring users seeking older records to the legacy archive / Municipal Clerk. HalifaxData does not assert completeness before 2016-01-12; earlier records remain a separate research path.
metadata.note: This checked-in inventory records official Halifax historical meeting/minutes discovery evidence only. It does not expand council_decisions.json by itself, and it does not assert payment, spending or wrongdoing.
